versions.changelog:
- Expanded the skill description to clarify detection of current media playing (song/video) and how it integrates with Discord Rich Presence.
- Added new example user queries and interactions, including "What video is playing?", and clarified response details.
- Improved explanation and grouping of use cases (query media, show/hide/override on Discord, auto/manual display).
- Updated download/setup links to the new GoodRP repository (isam-ahmed0/GoodRP).
- Refined documentation throughout for clarity and comprehensiveness.

- Initial release of goodrp-skill, providing Discord Rich Presence control for media playback via GoodRP.
- Query and display current media playback status (title, artist, album, type).
- Set, override, or clear Discord presence with "listening" or "watching" modes.
- Enable or disable automatic media showing on Discord.
- View current connection, configuration, and status state.
- Includes platform-specific setup instructions for MCP and HTTP API integration.
